lines.text: He is enthroned above the cherubim;
Great is the LORD in Zion;
He is exalted above all the peoples.
Let them praise Your great and awesome name—

pictures.scene: Fra Angelico, The Coronation of the Virgin — the crowned Lord seated on the high golden throne with the ranks of saints kneeling on the steps below, the LORD reigns and the nations tremble
pictures.name: pd_angelico_regeert

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, Christ in the Storm on the Lake of Galilee — the boat heaved up on the black wave with the sail tearing while the disciples cling on, let the earth quake before the One enthroned above the cherubim
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_beeft

pictures.scene: Andrea Mantegna, The Ascension — Christ carried up in the ring of angels while the watchers are left standing on the ground, He is exalted above all the peoples
pictures.name: pd_mantegna_verheven

pictures.scene: Jan van Eyck, The Singing Angels — the choir crowded over the open book with their mouths wide in song, let them praise Your great and awesome name
pictures.name: pd_eyck_heilig

pictures.scene: Peter Paul Rubens, The Judgement of Solomon — the king leaning from his throne to stop the sword and give the living child back to its mother, the mighty King loves justice
pictures.name: pd_rubens_recht

pictures.scene: Bartolomé Esteban Murillo, Jacob Laying Peeled Rods before the Flocks of Laban — Jacob at the watering troughs with the flocks coming down to drink, You have exercised justice and righteousness in Jacob
pictures.name: pd_murillo_jakob

pictures.scene: Dieric Bouts, Christ in the House of the Pharisee Simon — the woman bowed down at the Lord's feet while the table watches, worship at His footstool
pictures.name: pd_bouts_voetbank

pictures.scene: John Everett Millais, Victory O Lord! — Aaron and Hur holding up Moses' arms on the rock until the sun goes down, Moses and Aaron were among His priests
pictures.name: pd_millais_priesters
